claims.claim_text: The trained network is used to generate steering commands from a single front-facing center camera.
claims.normalized_text: The trained network generates steering commands from a single front-facing center camera.
claims.source_quote: The trained network is used to generate steering commands from a single front-facing center camera.

claims.claim_text: Training data was collected by driving on a wide variety of roads and in a diverse set of lighting and weather conditions.
claims.normalized_text: Training data includes diverse roads, lighting, and weather conditions.
claims.source_quote: Training data was collected by driving on a wide variety of roads and in a diverse set of lighting and weather conditions.

claims.claim_text: Most road data was collected in central New Jersey, although highway data was also collected from Illinois, Michigan, Pennsylvania, and New York.
claims.normalized_text: Road data was collected mainly in central New Jersey and highways in Illinois, Michigan, Pennsylvania, and New York.
claims.source_quote: Most road data was collected in central New Jersey, although highway data was also collected from Illinois, Michigan, Pennsylvania, and New York.

claims.claim_text: Other road types include two-lane roads (with and without lane markings), residential roads with parked cars, tunnels, and unpaved roads.
claims.normalized_text: Data includes two-lane roads, residential roads with parked cars, tunnels, and unpaved roads.
claims.source_quote: Other road types include two-lane roads (with and without lane markings), residential roads with parked cars, tunnels, and unpaved roads.

claims.claim_text: Data was collected in clear, cloudy, foggy, snowy, and rainy weather, both day and night.
claims.normalized_text: Data was collected across various weather conditions and times of day.
claims.source_quote: Data was collected in clear, cloudy, foggy, snowy, and rainy weather, both day and night.

claims.claim_text: In some instances, the sun was low in the sky, resulting in glare reﬂecting from the road surface and scattering from the windshield.
claims.normalized_text: Some data includes sun glare effects from low sun positions.
claims.source_quote: In some instances, the sun was low in the sky, resulting in glare reﬂecting from the road surface and scattering from the windshield.

claims.claim_text: Data was acquired using either our drive-by-wire test vehicle, which is a 2016 Lincoln MKZ, or using a 2013 Ford Focus with cameras placed in similar positions to those in the Lincoln.
claims.normalized_text: Data was acquired using a 2016 Lincoln MKZ or a 2013 Ford Focus with similarly placed cameras.
claims.source_quote: Data was acquired using either our drive-by-wire test vehicle, which is a 2016 Lincoln MKZ, or using a 2013 Ford Focus with cameras placed in similar positions to those in the Lincoln.

claims.claim_text: The system has no dependencies on any particular vehicle make or model.
claims.normalized_text: The system is vehicle-make and model independent.
claims.source_quote: The system has no dependencies on any particular vehicle make or model.

claims.claim_text: Drivers were encouraged to maintain full attentiveness, but otherwise drive as they usually do.
claims.normalized_text: Drivers maintained full attentiveness and drove normally during data collection.
claims.source_quote: Drivers were encouraged to maintain full attentiveness, but otherwise drive as they usually do.
